name: nidirect — getting an autism assessment and diagnosis
description: Northern Ireland public information on autism referral through local Health and Social Care Trust services, assessment, waiting and private-assessment checks.
intended_use: Use as the national Northern Ireland-facing starting route for adult or child autism assessment and local Trust navigation.
audience_or_context: Adults, children and young people, families and supporters in Northern Ireland.
limitations: Operational assessment pathways and waits vary between HSC Trusts and age groups.
People considering private assessment are advised to check whether their Trust has accepted the provider's reports and what follow-up is available; this is not a guarantee of acceptance.
The page cannot establish whether a particular person is autistic.
cost_or_access_notes: Publicly accessible online; HSC assessment access depends on local Trust pathways. Private assessment has separate costs.
conflicts_of_interest: nidirect is the Northern Ireland government public-information service; ND Oracle records the official route without assuming local availability or outcome.

provenance.method: Current nidirect autism assessment page checked on 2026-09-03 for referral, Trust variation, waiting and private-assessment wording. Listing is descriptive and claimless.
